description: Election Commission - E. H. S. Edirisinghe was selected as the member of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha, S. Liyanage was selected as the member of the Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha and J. S. Herath was selected as the member of the Padavi Sripura Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to various reasons including non-attendance and party membership changes. It involves electoral processes at the local authority level under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including declarations of selected members by returning officers. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters and filling elected positions in local government bodies.
